_comment: Alerts of the ZAP API scan of the gateway that are accepted, as "<plugin id> <risk>": "reason" (scripts/dast_baseline.py). Empty: every alert of risk Low or above fails the nightly run. The plugin ids are in the report (zap.html in the run's artifacts) and at https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/alerts/.
100000 low: GET /ran-nf-oam/managed-entities/{ref}/config of an element that does not exist answers 503 ENDPOINT_UNREACHABLE: a deliberate answer pinned by ran-nf-oam/tests/test_dispatch_reliability.py (an element with no registered O1 adaptor, which an unknown one is, is unreachable). Whether it should be a 404 is an open API decision (smo/OPEN_ITEMS.md), not a vulnerability; ZAP's rule 100000 flags any 5xx.
